answers.core: It is a simple programmatic simplifcation/shorthand and would be pointless if implemented as a plugin/addon.
answers.workaround:
If not used often the regular origin or translation attributes can be utilized albeit at a cost since some nodes can be shifted by moving their origin and some require translation. This can become cumbersome.

self.origin.x = anothernode.get_translation().x
self.origin.y = anothernode.get_translation().y
self.origin.z = anothernode.get_translation().z
